versions.content: The Service Discovery Module shall stay in the Main Phase as long as the following conditions apply:  Client Service was set to state " SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED " (indicated by a call of Sd_ClientServiceSetState() or Sd_ServiceGroupStart())  IP address assigned and can be used (i.e. S d _LocalIpA ddrAssignmentChg has been called with status TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ASSIGNED ) .

The Service Discovery Module shall stay in the Main Phase as long as the following conditions apply: • Client Service was set to state "SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_REQUESTED" (indi- cated by a call of Sd_ClientServiceSetState() or Sd_ServiceGroupStart()) • IP address assigned and can be used (i.e. Sd_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg has been called with status TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ASSIGNED).
